notes: LaunchToken is Pulse (PULSE), a plain fixed-supply ERC-20 with 18 decimals and no constructor arguments. PulseDrone permanently binds PULSE through its sole address constructor argument, $token. It provides free soulbound Drone minting, heartbeats, fully onchain art and instant staking withdrawals; staking determines rank and pays no rewards. PulseDrone has no owner or administrative powers and requires no initialization calls. DroneArt is an internal library inlined into PulseDrone, not a separate deployment. The factory supplies the pool, MerkleDistributor and initialization-only pool guard. The pool pairs with IMD at a 1.25% fee. The manifest initialPrice is the prescribed reference value; services derive the effective opening price from the launch policy and token ordering. Policy and signed artifact linkage are service responsibilities.
